item.title: Group report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Update the Python CSV stdin report to total by account and currency, output header account,currency,total_cents, and sort rows by account then currency. Accept legacy CSV without a currency column and treat every row as USD. Validate any currency column value as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits status 2. Update README and ensure python3 -m unittest passes. Commit the change in this repository.

item.title: Add currency column and validation to ledger
item.brief: Update the Rust TSV-to-CSV CLI to accept an optional fourth TSV field containing an ISO 4217 currency code represented as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Default missing currency to USD. Emit CSV columns date,account,amount_cents,currency and include currency in each row. Malformed currency must print an error naming the 1-based input line number to stderr and exit status 2; preserve status 1 for all other input errors. Update README and ensure cargo test passes. Commit the change in this repository.

pr.body: Updated src/lib.rs to parse optional currency and enforce exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; updated src/main.rs to use status 2 for currency errors while retaining status 1 for other input errors. Added coverage for USD defaulting, supplied currency, malformed codes, line numbering, and both exit statuses. Updated README.md. Checks: `cargo fmt -- --check`, `cargo test` (4 tests), and `git diff --check` passed. No external ISO 4217 registry lookup is performed; validation is syntactic as specified.
pr.summary: Added an optional currency field to ledger input and CSV output. Missing currency now defaults to USD; invalid currency reports its input line and exits 2. Before: three-column CSV with no currency field. Now: date,account,amount_cents,currency on every row.
